waypoints.name: Hannegan Pass Trailhead
waypoints.note: End of Forest Road 32; alternate approach via the Chilliwack River Trail then the Easy Ridge climbers' path.
waypoints.directions: From Glacier, drive SR 542 (Mount Baker Highway) about 13 miles east and, just before the bridge over the Nooksack River, turn left onto FS Road 32. At 1.3 miles keep left on Ruth Creek Road and drive 5.4 miles to the road end at Hannegan Campground and the trailhead, about 3,100 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required.

waypoints.name: Whatcom Peak
waypoints.note: Approach crosses Easy Ridge, Easy Peak, and the Imperfect Impasse to Perfect Pass (~6,300 ft), then snowfields and 3rd- to 4th-class rock up the south face/spur.
waypoints.directions: Hike Trail #674 about 4 miles to Hannegan Pass, descend past Boundary Camp, ford the Chilliwack River and climb the old Easy Ridge path to Easy Saddle. Follow the ridge over Easy Peak, past the Imperfect Impasse (often bypassed by dropping to about 4,400 ft and climbing an exposed class 4 step), to Perfect Pass, then climb north up the south snowfield to the col and the short, exposed crest to the summit.
